purpose: Resolve the outward -0.625 boundary hit from local refinement using a fresh common-random-number comparison that includes an inner anchor and progressively more-negative values.

fixed_stack.authority: synchronous Tetrp TL with authority-validated reset-safe placement transport

grid_reason: The previous 40-pair refinement selected -0.625 at its outward boundary with 54-26 KO and +14 net paired sweeps.
-0.5 is repeated on the same new seeds as an inner anchor, so this stage can choose among its values without comparing raw scores across different seed sets.
-0.75 and -0.875 extend in equal 0.125 steps. The older coarse -1.0 point was weak, so -1.0 is not spent again unless the new -0.875 boundary wins.

sampling.common_random_numbers: All four boundary-extension values use the same 40 fresh asymmetric seed pairs.
sampling.pair_design: Game A candidate gets seed X in slot0 and incumbent seed Y in slot1; Game B swaps profile assignment so candidate gets seed Y in slot1.
sampling.independence: The 40 asymmetric pairs are the experimental units; 80 games are not 80 independent observations.

integrity_gates: Every value must have 40 complete asymmetric pairs / 80 scored games with no harness failures.
Each pair must contain candidate once in slot0 and once in slot1.
The one-lock placement-transport guard must remain enabled.
Any correctness failure blocks finalist selection until repaired; do not count a malformed game as a loss.

finalist_selection.eligibility: A value must have positive net paired sweeps and >40/80 candidate KO wins.
finalist_selection.boundary_rule: If -0.875 is the selected best value, extend outward again with fresh seeds before fixing a finalist. Otherwise the best eligible value in this common-seed grid becomes the fixed H9 finalist.
finalist_selection.no_positive_region: If no value meets eligibility, pause H9 rather than force a finalist.
finalist_selection.no_promotion: Boundary extension can select a finalist only. It cannot promote H9.

next_if_finalist_selected: Preregister one fixed H9 finalist against corrected_legacy_h12 for about 200 fresh asymmetric pairs / 400 games. Promotion requires that independent confirmation.
